sources.snippet: YOLOv8-Segmentation Real‑time object segmentation optimized for mobile and edge by Ultralytics. Ultralytics YOLOv8 is a machine learning model that predicts bounding boxes, segmentation masks and classes of objects in an image. Note: YOLOv8-Segmentation cannot be downloaded directly due to licensing restrictions.
